speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The combination of a continuous machinery-like murmur, non-blanching skin lesions, cataracts, and sensorineural deafness is the classic tetrad of this congenital infection.
